memberdef.initializer:
= "This program demonstrates the Meta-Program Level where the details " "of a preprocessor are specified. In this case this program " "represents the MetaProgram to build a preprocessor for the A++/P++ " "array class.\n\n"
"Currently the grammars are defined, the execution of this program " "(a C++ program) generates the source code for defining the grammars " "to be used in building a preprocessor. So this example does not " "yet build all the code required to build a preprocessor (the rest " "is specified in the ROSE/src directory structure)."
